description: An ET22 with 20 loaded heavy wagons 764 (Uaai, 84 t of machinery each, KE, G; about 2650 t) on the line of et41_coal_td_downgrade_restriction: down 20 per mille into a 20 km/h restriction 400 m long, then to the signal at stop. The train is to keep above 10 km/h through the restriction (#187: it almost stops).
xfail: #187, #263: down 20 per mille the AI holds the 20 km/h restriction by applying and releasing the train brake in turn (handle 0, then 1.25-2.75, then 0 again); the release of this G train takes 10-15 s, so each one comes late and the train dips to 8.5 km/h, below the 10 km/h #263 counts as a defect. It doesn't stop. Known limitation of the AI, not fixed here
